items.caption:
Some people sleep 20 hours a day, for weeks.
Kleine-Levin syndrome is a rare disorder of recurring episodes of extreme sleep. Between them, people are usually normal. Its cause is unknown.

Walruses can go 3 days with almost no sleep.
Young captive walruses swam for up to 84 hours, awake almost all the time, then rested on land for hours. They can also sleep floating or lying on the bottom.
